doctrine: Docs render what product truth declares. Manual prose may explain truth, but it may not define truth.

manifests.title: Administration
manifests.summary: Tenant administration for audit logs, members, invites, roles, permissions, and tenant settings.

workflows.title: Member lifecycle administration
workflows.summary: Administrators invite members, assign roles, and audit membership changes.

workflows.title: Tenant settings management
workflows.summary: Administrators configure general, branding, AI provider, storage, and optional custom domain verification.

actions.title: Manage members and invites
actions.summary: Review members, send invites, and update role assignments.

actions.title: Manage tenant settings
actions.summary: Update tenant settings and validate external provider connectivity.

apis.summary: Internal: resolve verified custom domain hostname to tenant slug for Edge proxy (Bearer MIDDLEWARE_TENANT_LOOKUP_SECRET).

errors.title: Administration permission missing
errors.mitigation: Confirm the user has the required tenant administration role and permission assignment.

troubleshooting.title: Provider connection test fails
troubleshooting.symptom: AI or storage settings test requests return a failure.
troubleshooting.resolution: Check tenant credentials, provider endpoint configuration, and provider-side availability.

manifests.title: AI Assistant
manifests.summary: Tenant-aware AI assistant conversations and generated UI responses.

workflows.title: Assistant conversation
workflows.summary: Members ask questions and receive contextual assistant responses for tenant data.

actions.title: Start assistant conversation
actions.summary: Create or continue a conversation in the tenant assistant workspace.

apis.summary: Send chat messages to the assistant runtime.

errors.title: Conversation cannot be loaded
errors.mitigation: Confirm tenant context, conversation ownership, and assistant service availability.

troubleshooting.title: Assistant does not respond
troubleshooting.symptom: The chat interface does not produce a response.
troubleshooting.resolution: Check model provider settings, tenant AI configuration, and server logs for provider errors.

manifests.title: Authentication and Tenant Access
manifests.summary: Authentication, tenant selection, optional self-service first organization, tenant login, and invite-token entry points.

workflows.title: User sign-in
workflows.summary: Users authenticate and resolve their tenant context.

workflows.title: Invite acceptance
workflows.summary: Invited users enter a tenant through an invite token.

workflows.title: Self-service first organization
workflows.summary: When enabled, users with no memberships can create a tenant and become admin.

actions.title: Select tenant
actions.summary: Choose an authorized tenant after successful authentication.

actions.title: Create organization
actions.summary: Server action to create a tenant, roles, membership, and person when the feature flag is on.

apis.summary: Auth.js route handler for authentication lifecycle requests.

errors.title: No tenant membership available
errors.mitigation: Confirm the user has an active tenant membership or a valid invite.

troubleshooting.title: User cannot enter tenant
troubleshooting.symptom: Authenticated user is redirected away from a tenant.
troubleshooting.resolution: Verify tenant membership, role assignment, and invite status.

manifests.title: Dashboard
manifests.summary: Landing and tenant dashboard surfaces for workspace entry, activity, stats, and quick actions.

workflows.title: Workspace entry
workflows.summary: Users land in the tenant workspace and review activity, stats, and quick actions.

actions.title: Review workspace status
actions.summary: Inspect tenant metrics, profile completion, contextual tips, and recent activity.

errors.title: Dashboard stats unavailable
errors.mitigation: Check tenant context and dashboard stats service execution.

troubleshooting.title: Dashboard appears empty
troubleshooting.symptom: Dashboard cards show no activity or metrics.
troubleshooting.resolution: Confirm the tenant has seeded data, memberships, and accessible dashboard services.

manifests.title: Documentation Evidence Pipeline
manifests.summary: Fumadocs-rendered evidence surface generated from governed product truth.

workflows.title: Documentation evidence generation
workflows.summary: Validate manifests, build the docs inventory graph, generate MDX/JSON, and render through Fumadocs.

actions.title: Generate documentation evidence
actions.summary: Run the documentation generation pipeline from manifest-backed product truth.

actions.title: Submit documentation page feedback
actions.summary: Validate, rate-limit, and append a page-level feedback event for a Fumadocs-rendered documentation page.

apis.summary: Expose the Fumadocs page index for LLM-friendly discovery. Optional `locale` query selects the language tree (default `en`).
Expose all documentation pages as clean Markdown for LLM consumption. Optional `locale` query selects the language tree (default `en`).
Expose one locale-aware documentation page as clean Markdown for LLM consumption.
Expose locale-aware Fumadocs search results from the generated documentation source.
Expose an RSS feed for generated documentation evidence pages.
Generate Open Graph images for documentation pages (next/og + Fumadocs UI template). Static path ends with image.png.

errors.title: Docs contract validation failed
errors.mitigation: Fix manifest IDs, owners, routes, permissions, APIs, errors, or troubleshooting references.

errors.title: Docs feedback validation failed
errors.mitigation: Submit feedback only for canonical /docs pages with a supported opinion and bounded message.

errors.title: Docs feedback origin rejected
errors.mitigation: Ensure the request Origin matches the deployment Host or X-Forwarded-Host.

errors.title: Docs feedback rate limit exceeded
errors.mitigation: Wait for the feedback submission window to reset before retrying.

errors.title: Docs feedback request context unavailable
errors.mitigation: Confirm the deployment provides AUTH_SECRET and enough request headers to derive a rate-limit key.

errors.title: Docs feedback storage failed
errors.mitigation: Check database connectivity and the docs_page_feedback_events migration state.

troubleshooting.title: Generated docs are stale
troubleshooting.resolution: Run pnpm docs:generate and commit the regenerated evidence files.

troubleshooting.title: Docs feedback submission fails
troubleshooting.symptom: A documentation page feedback form shows a submission failure.
troubleshooting.resolution: Check origin headers, AUTH_SECRET, rate-limit history, and the docs_page_feedback_events database migration.

manifests.title: GitHub OAuth Integration
manifests.summary: GitHub OAuth connection entry points for tenant and user integration flows.

workflows.title: GitHub OAuth connection
workflows.summary: Start and complete GitHub OAuth for integration setup.

actions.title: Connect GitHub account
actions.summary: Generate GitHub OAuth state and redirect to GitHub authorization.

errors.title: GitHub OAuth failed
errors.mitigation: Validate OAuth state, GitHub app credentials, and callback configuration.

troubleshooting.title: GitHub callback fails
troubleshooting.symptom: GitHub redirects back but the integration is not connected.
troubleshooting.resolution: Confirm callback URL, OAuth state, app credentials, and tenant/user context.

manifests.title: Integration Control Plane
manifests.summary: Tenant integration administration for GitHub settings, webhooks, metrics, sync readiness, conflicts, and runs.

workflows.title: GitHub integration setup
workflows.summary: Configure GitHub credentials, mappings, readiness, and username assignment.

workflows.title: Integration conflict resolution
workflows.summary: Review sync conflicts and resolve mapped integration data issues.

actions.title: Review integration metrics
actions.summary: Inspect integration readiness, run history, metrics, and conflicts.

actions.title: Configure webhooks
actions.summary: Create and maintain outbound webhook integration settings.

errors.title: Integration permission missing
errors.mitigation: Assign admin:integrations or the more specific integration permission required by the endpoint.

errors.title: Integration readiness failed
errors.mitigation: Review credentials, mappings, and required organization membership data.

troubleshooting.title: Integration metrics unavailable
troubleshooting.symptom: The control plane cannot show metrics or readiness state.
troubleshooting.resolution: Confirm permissions, integration credentials, and latest sync run status.

manifests.title: Member Profile
manifests.summary: Member profile and profile settings surfaces.

workflows.title: Profile settings update
workflows.summary: Members review and update profile details in tenant context.

actions.title: Update profile
actions.summary: Submit profile changes through the profile settings form.

errors.title: Profile update failed
errors.mitigation: Validate submitted profile data and confirm the user has an active tenant session.

troubleshooting.title: Profile settings do not save
troubleshooting.symptom: Profile changes are rejected or not persisted.
troubleshooting.resolution: Check required fields, session state, and profile update service errors.
